[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]The buggy's gone! He's going[XENO:n ]
to Colony 6 on his own![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Stupid kid![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]We have to hurry. Something bad's gonna happen.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]What did you see?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
A deep valley... Everything's engulfed in flames...[XENO:wait wait=key ]
There's a black shadow...[XENO:wait wait=key ]
It kills Juujuu.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Is it the Mechon with the metal face?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Where does it happen?[XENO:n ]
Is it near Colony 6?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I'm not sure. I think so.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT5 ]Let's get after him, Shulk![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Hold on a second! What was all that about?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I know you won't believe this...[XENO:n ]
but Shulk can see the future.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]The future? That's not possible.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]That's what I thought too.[XENO:n ]
I still can't explain this.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
But that vision I had will come true unless we stop it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
So you're telling me Juujuu's in danger?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT22 ]Believe it or don't believe it, that's your call.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT24 ]

But I wouldn't be standing here[XENO:n ]
if it weren't for Shulk's visions.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Juujuu...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I can't say I believe you.[XENO:n ]
But what have I got to lose?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]I like the way you think![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Carna, you're...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No, nothing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT22 ]What are you doing?[XENO:n ]
Let's go and find Juujuu![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]When you talk like that, Rein, you[XENO:n ]
sound just like Gado![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]
That's how I know it's not worth arguing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT2 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]What am I, some kind of Gado substitute?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:jaw jaw=off ]That thing kills Carna too.[XENO:n ]
I saw it in the vision.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:jaw jaw=off ]But I can't stop her coming with us.[XENO:n ]
I don't know how I can protect her.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:jaw jaw=off ]But I have to do it.[XENO:n ]
I WILL change the future.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
